messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: integrate_ode in Stan
parts:
Hi,

Is there a possibility to code customized integrate_ode function in stan? The intention is to replace exact ODE integration with approximated by using orthogonal collocation or splines. Eventually this customized could could be merged with mainstream Stan.

If it is possible it would be great to learn how to.

Thanks,
Linas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] integrate_ode in Stan
parts:
There's nothing for approximate ODEs in there now. If you want
to contribute C++ code for new functions, we have some Wiki pages
to help you follow the process. But just coding a function in
Stan itself is going to be just as efficient as doing it in C++
unless you implement custom derivatives.

This is one of the goals of our new ONR grant, so we'll
be working on some approximate solutions ourselves. I don't
know mucha bout it, so can't say anything more specific.

- Bob

messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] integrate_ode in Stan
parts:
Bob,


Currently ODEs are handled by something like:
y_hat <- integrate_ode(sho, y0, t0, ts, theta, x_r, x_i);

I thought that it should be possible to replace integrate_ode with some custom code [my_integrate_ode(y0, t0, ts, theta, x_r, x_i)] which calculates y_hat for each time point in ts. Current integrate_ode does exact integration. I am thinking about replacing it with approximate integration where system of ODEs is replaced by a system of algebraic equations. Recently I saw posts where folks are using splines to achieve the same purpose. Unfortunately it is impossible to code this in Stan modeling language, one has to do this in C++ (at least this is my understanding which may be wrong). What are the guidelines/requirements to create custom function my_integrate_ode?

Thank you,
Linas

messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] integrate_ode in Stan
parts:
Bob,

Thank you. Stan currently has integrate_ode which integrates first order ODEs exactly. I would like to add the function integrate_ode_orthogonal_collocation which will integrate first order ODEs approximately using orthogonal collocation (http://www.tc1.ch.tum.de/fileadmin/w00bhu/www/Vorlesungen/Reaktordesign__Praktikum_/Votrag_Kollokation.pdf). I am not sure if it could be implemented via Stan's modeling language. I know that some folks already implemented ode integration using splines. It would be great to learn more from them.
Linas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] integrate_ode in Stan
parts:
That just looks like a sum over finitely many terms.
No reason you couldn't implement it in Stan directly.

The point of doing things in C++ is usually because
there's a function available in C++ not available in the Stan
language or because you want to make it more efficient
by implementing custom derivatives.

- Bob
